title: Customer or Writer Confirmation Notes
summary: This topic is dominated by terse confirmation phrases from customers or service writers, with too little context in most fragments to determine a clear sentiment.

negative.summary: The only negative example reflects a customer deferring attention to a non-emergency issue until a later service visit.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly record procedural confirmations such as customers or writers confirming a condition, software version, or operating state without evaluative detail.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are extremely short confirmation statements with insufficient context to identify a concrete issue or sentiment.
The topic appears procedural rather than experiential, so the examples do not support strong conclusions about customer satisfaction or vehicle performance.
The sampled fragments reference several unrelated confirmed items, such as software version, engine state, and unspecified conditions, which limits thematic coherence.
